hints.title: Pairing Superior Elements
hints.text: To maximize matches where perm[i] > nums[i], sort nums and match each element with the smallest available element strictly greater than it.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Sorted Matching
hints.text: Maintain pointer i for smaller elements and pointer j for larger candidate superiors.

hints.title: Monotonic Advancement
hints.text: Whenever nums[j] > nums[i], advance both i and j; otherwise, only advance j.

hints.title: Sorted Two-Pointer Matching Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); single linear sweep takes O(n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies greedy two-pointer matching on the sorted array.
